programme.title: SHOW K-POP
programme.desc: Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias. FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. Premieres October 19, 2026 | LIVE every Monday at 6 PM (KST)https://www.showkpop.comPlease catch the reruns!Broadcast Schedule (KST)- Monday: 6:00 PM (Live Broadcast / Premiere)  - Friday: 12:50 PM, 6:00 PM- Saturday: 6:00 AM- Sunday: 10:50 AM, 8:50 PM- Monday: 2:00 AMThere is no on-demand replay available. Please catch one of the scheduled rebroadcasts.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: TALK ROOM
programme.desc: What is the true strength of the K-people leading the K-Wave? We invite the most talked-about figures—those who influence not just Korea but the world—into our studio for intimate one-on-one conversations. Through their stories, the secrets behind overcoming failure and achieving success, and even private small talk, we uncover what makes them extraordinary. When you listen to someone’s story, you enter their world. In this time of dialogue with the most Korean yet most global K-people, we step into the K-Universe.

programme.title: WITH SCIENCE, WE LIVE
programme.desc: Humanity has learned from the past, transcended the present, and dreamed of the future."With Science, We Live"explores the frontiers of science alongside some of the world’s leading thinkers, offering insights into what lies ahead and uncovering new possibilities.In an era of rapid change, where are we headed?As we navigate between the vast universe and the smallness of human existence, we reconsider the direction we must take.Now, in this very moment, we imagine the future shaped by our choices—and move forward toward it.

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection. Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers. Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Beauty On and Off
programme.desc: K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing. So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products. Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”. Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: Countryside Escape
programme.desc: A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea. More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection. Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers. Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: Talking Movies
programme.desc: Talking Movies looks at the films that made waves at the BFI London Film Festival and the New York Film Festival in October. Tom Brook explores the film Elsinore, which contains a magnetic performance from Andrew Scott portraying the actor Ian Charleson, and is already being tipped for Oscar glory. Martin McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine also made a big impression and we talk to the director as well as the cast from the festival red carpet. Wedaeli Chibelushi offers her thoughts on the new African drama Congo Boy and Emma Jones looks at Spanish film La Bola Negra, which has been earning rave reviews and is being talked about as a serious contender for the Best Film category at Academy Awards in 2027. Plus, we head to the USA for a look at the New York Film Festival which opened with the crime drama Paper Tiger. Other standout films there included the documentary Once Upon A Time in Harlem and Mike Leigh's Tender Loving Care.

programme.title: AI Decoded
programme.desc: AI Decoded examines the growing role of artificial intelligence in the US midterm elections. From AI-generated political adverts and deepfake videos to chatbot election advice and algorithm-driven feeds, AI is now embedded in every stage of the information ecosystem. Political campaigns are using AI to create content faster and cheaper than ever before. At the same time, convincing fake videos, synthetic ads and coordinated bot networks are making it harder for voters to separate fact from fiction. With millions of people now turning to chatbots for political information, are we entering an era where AI doesn't just influence elections, but shapes how voters understand them?

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Nawal Al-Maghafi reports from Yemen's front lines, where Houthi forces are posing the most serious threat in years to the city of Taiz, raising fears of a major escalation in a conflict that has endured for more than a decade. We also trace the roots of Yemen's war, exploring how the country's strategic location has drawn it into a struggle involving Saudi Arabia, Iran and the United States. Plus: BBC Mundo travels to Panama's Coiba Island, a biodiversity hotspot, to explore how a former prison colony helped preserve a rare and fragile natural world.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: In the second leg of his Ghanaian adventure, Clive heads 80 miles from the capital city of Accra to the picturesque fishing ports of Cape Coast and Elmina, where he digs deep into his ancestral roots. He takes part in one of Ghana's most exciting tribal celebrations as he’s welcomed by the Fante people. He's given a new name by elders from the group, as well as a personalised Fante flag that celebrates both his West African and Jamaican roots. As part of this journey, Clive makes a difficult but moving visit to a former slave fort to discover some of what his ancestors went through. And, in a personal first, Clive gets to dance in a hip-hop video with rising star Kojo Vypa.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Why are record amounts of money pouring into sport? The LA Lakers are starting the new NBA as the most expensive sports team in history after being bought for $12.5bn. Record sums have also been spent on the NFL's Seattle Seahawks and English Premier League teams Liverpool and Chelsea in recent weeks. Is it really being driven by the search for an AI proof investment? Sal Galatioto is the man billionaires call when they want to buy or sell a sports team and he explains why the prices keep on climbing. Leading TV sports rights executive Daniel Cohen, of Octagon Global Media Consulting, explains the impact this is all having on how we watch and how much we pay. Ben Thompson also hears from the billionaire founder and CEO of Fanatics, Michael Rubin, and how fans are continuing to splash out on replica shirts, trading cards and other merchandise.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: The show that reaches through your screen, to tell you the tech stories that ready matter. Hosted by BBC technology journalist Thomas Germain and social media expert Professor Jessica Maddox, The Interface dives into the stories, trends, apps, gadgets, algorithms and internet obsessions shaping how we live, work, think and connect. From AI and influencers to memes, data leaks, cybersecurity and the weirdest corners of the web, The Interface explores what happens when technology collides with real life. Cutting through the hype, the hosts unpack the platforms, products and online phenomena that increasingly shape our choices, our culture and our sense of self - whether we like it or not! Sharp, insightful and often very funny, The Interface examines our relationship with technology in all its messy, brilliant, absurd and world-changing glory. Along the way, it tackles one of the biggest questions of our age: what kind of future are the likes of Elon Musk, Chat GPT and all the other Silicon Valley giants building, and does anyone really want to live there?

programme.title: Cheers: Rebecca, steh uns bei!
programme.desc: Seit Rebecca nicht mehr Geschäftsführerin ist, geht es im Cheers drunter und drüber. Sam muss feststellen, dass er dem Posten nicht gewachsen ist. Er will Rebecca zurückholen.

programme.title: Cheers: Ruhm ist vergänglich
programme.desc: In der Presse wird kolportiert, Robin Colcord habe seine Freiheit und sein Vermögen für eine Frau geopfert. Rebecca fürchtet nun die Reporterscharen, die über das Cheers hereinbrechen werden.

programme.title: Cheers: Mamas Liebling
programme.desc: Stolz gibt Cliff bekannt, dass er sich endlich von seiner Mutter emanzipiert habe. Tatsächlich: Als sie zu Besuch kommt, eröffnet Cliff seiner entsetzten Mutter, dass sie in einem Hotel nächtigen müsse.

programme.title: Cheers: Norm als Bürgerrechtler
programme.desc: Norm ist schwer deprimiert. Nicht einmal sein Bier schmeckt ihm. Der Grund: Sein Lieblingslokal soll abgerissen werden. Frasier schlägt vor, Norman solle etwas gegen die Schließung des Lokals unternehmen.

programme.title: Cheers: Dumm ist, wer Dummes tut
programme.desc: Frasier und Lilith zermürben sich ihre Köpfe darüber, dass ihr Sohn offenbar nur durchschnittlich intelligent ist. Rebecca plagt währenddessen die sexuelle Enthaltsamkeit. Robin schreibt ihr einen schlüpfrigen Brief aus dem Knast.

programme.title: Cheers: Der böse Nachbar Sam
programme.desc: Sams gute Laune ist gedämpft. Der New Yorker Edelgastronom John Allen Hill bezieht mit seinem neuen Restaurant den Raum über dem Cheers. Hill diktiert die neuen Regeln im Haus. Seine Yuppie-Klientel benutzt zudem das Cheers als Wartehalle.

programme.title: Cheers: Eine hochoffizielle Lüge
programme.desc: Woody spielt in einem Werbespot für das vegetarisches Getränk ,,Veggie-Boy" mit. Als der Spot zum ersten Mal ausgestrahlt wird, finden sich alle im Cheers ein. Woody befindet sich jedoch in einem Gewissenskonflikt.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Kreditkarte

programme.title: Cheers: Der Franzose
programme.desc: Woody ist außer sich vor Freude: Seine Freundin Kelly kehrt nach einem Jahr aus Frankreich zurück. Allerdings kommt sie in Begleitung eines charmanten Franzosen. Woody fragt Sam um Rat, wie er den Nebenbuhler ausstechen kann.

programme.title: Cheers: Das Familientreffen
programme.desc: Seit Jahren hat Carla ihre Mutter nicht mehr gesehen. Nun liegt die Frau im Sterben und bittet Carla zu sich. Sie erinnert ihre Tochter an eine alte Familientradition:Einer von Carlas Söhnen muss den Vornamen des Vaters und den Nachnamen der Mutter tragen

programme.title: Cheers: Wer anderen eine Grube gräbt

programme.title: Cheers: Rebeccas Hochzeit – Teil 1

programme.title: Cheers: Rebeccas Hochzeit – Teil 2
programme.desc: Rebecca hat im Alkoholrausch erkannt, dass sie Robin nicht liebt. Deshalb kann sie ihn auch nicht heiraten. Sam glaubt, dass er in den nächsten Tagen besondere Rücksicht auf sie nehmen muss.

programme.title: Cheers: Lieber schwul als heiraten
programme.desc: Rebecca hat ihre geplatzte Hochzeit mit Robin noch nicht ganz verkraftet. Endlich kann Sam sie dazu bewegen, ihr verschwitztes Brautkleid auszuziehen. Durch ein Missverständnis glaubt Rebecca, Sam sei in sie verliebt.

programme.title: Cheers: Nur einmal pro Jahr

programme.title: Cheers: Der Immobilienkrieg

programme.title: Cheers: Alle Macht den Frauen

programme.title: Cheers: Chili im Cheers

programme.desc: Bill Kurtis examines one of the most infamous cold cases in Los Angeles history.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Looks at how law enforcers stick with cases for many years, using fresh evidence to win convictions or to free prisoners who were wrongfully jailed. We examine the unsolved murder of Hogan's Heroes star Bob Crane.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In June 1985, a 20-year-old "Sucker Day" Festival Queen is found brutalized. The small community of Nixa, Missouri, is certain her blood is on the hands of a local wealthy businessman, but after 25 years DNA reveals the true killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: In 1983, Navy seamen Sonny Grotton left base for a long weekend at home. But as he pulled into his driveway, a gunman killed him. And in 1993, former state trooper Doug Wright claimed his estranged wife shot and killed herself in their home.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: When a woman is found murdered in her mobile home, police make two shocking discoveries--her husband may not only have been the killer, but he may have also killed his first wife 31 years before.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A new fingerprint identification system helps detectives track down a killer after three years of searching. And a Georgia investigator gets to the bottom of a 16-year-old murder case when he discovers the victim's body -- in the bottom of a well.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: Killer on Campus / The Bow Hunter
programme.desc: Thirty-two years after the killing of University of Michigan law student Jane Mixer, police use DNA found on her pantyhose to finally track down the killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A boy's toy Batmobile car provides an important clue for detectives struggling to make a case against a serial killer who stalks and kills waitresses.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: A 23-year-old teacher vanished the evening before Easter after giving confession. Her body was later found floating in a drainage canal. At the time, a key witness hinted that a member of the Catholic clergy may have been responsible.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy is charged with the murder of his sister, but his public defender believes the real killer is still on the loose. And two deteriorated slides, made 16 years earlier, give police the evidence they need to reopen the cold case.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: The Flaming Gorge Falls/Caught In The Mail
programme.desc: A man suspected of the cold case murder of his wife and son hatches a new plot to kill his mother and father; and detectives solve the 20-year-old murder of a teenager by tricking her killer into licking an envelope.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: When a Nevada couple demands the return of a baby they had sold to another couple, the burned body of the baby turns up in Arizona. Then, a man discovers a barrel in his crawlspace that contains the body of a woman who has been dead for decades.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.sub-title: Mistaken for a Killer/The Boy and the Monster
programme.desc: Advances in DNA technology that take place over 20 years help police to finally identify the man who brutally stabbed two women to death.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In August 1972, the body of Jody Loomis is found in the woods. 34 years later, the killer's DNA is recovered from Jody's old clothing but it isn't matched until 2018.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: In Wisconsin, advances in forensic clay modeling help investigators identify a murder victim whose skin was stripped from her head, neck, and legs. And in California, police track down two boys who enjoy satanic rituals and setting fires.

Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una mujer desaparece y su esposo se convierte en el principal sospechoso – especialmente después de que la policía encuentra una gran mancha de sangre en la alfombra de su habitación.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2000, Kristine Fitzhugh no se presentó a su clase de música y su esposo Ken la encontró muerta al pie de las escaleras de su casa de Palo Alto. Tras una investigación adicional, el luminol revela evidencia de un asesinato en la cocina.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Un disparo en la oscuridad
programme.desc: Una mujer es asesinada a tiros. ¿Pero fue un homicidio o un suicidio? Se necesitaría la experiencia de expertos forenses y dos juicios con jurado para determinar el destino del asesino acusado.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A rifle in a shopping mall, a syringe of potassium chloride and a syringe of insulin, each in the hands of a mentally disturbed woman, lead to the tragic end of many lives.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love to Death
programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Hearts of Stone
programme.desc: Deadly Women are not always the ones you expect. They are not the strangers lurking in the dark, they are a young mother, a supportive wife and a grandmother - all killers. Behind their loving masquerade lies a wake of family horror and pain.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women burn madly with jealousy, an anger so deep they’ll kill to satisfy it. What makes them turn from “green with envy” to “lethal with jealousy?" Find out as we explore their hearts of darkness.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: In some cases, the transformation from everyday woman to brutal killer is activated by a man. A boyfriend or husband can become the focus of a deadly obsession.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bonds of Love
programme.desc: Dog and Beth are finally getting married! They've been together for more than ten years but Dog is determined, as he puts it, to "marry his common law wife the Christian way."

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: To Love and to Cherish
programme.desc: Dog and Beth are off to the Big Island for their wedding. They hope to relax for a few days but it turns out Leland has a fugitive he needs to catch and despite the time limit, neither Dog nor Beth can resist the opportunity to catch a fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bustin' with Justin
programme.desc: Dog and the team must deal with misleading informants, belligerent boaters, and angry drunks when they go after Kimberly, a traffic offender with over 20 violations. And if that isn't enough, Dog has another problem - Duane Lee is sick.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Run Fugitive, Run
programme.desc: When the team hunts for Steven, a fugitive with a history of domestic abuse, they seek help from his girlfriend, who's been a victim of his abuse. Meanwhile, Beth trains for a 5K race to help raise awareness about domestic abuse.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Vegas or Bust
programme.desc: Dog is going to be the keynote speaker at the annual Profession Bail Agents convention in Las Vegas, but before he leaves he's got to clear two cases from his docket - Heidi and Stephanie.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Playing Possum
programme.desc: Tim's got a big problem. Owen has failed to appear in court. He's on bond for serious drug charges and now Tim could lose $30,000 if he doesn't catch Owen. With Dog's help he tries to track down the co-signer but they come up dry.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rainy Day Woman
programme.desc: It's been raining for days and the team is going a little stir crazy, but Dog has the cure; a good hunt. Maui has failed to appear on a drug charge and the team has just one lead. She was recently spotted during a bust at a local chop shop garage.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ticket to Ride
programme.desc: Dog decides it's time to outfit the Da Kine crew with new SUVs. After a quick visit to their local dealership, they go after Jasmine, a woman whose criminal record includes over 37 arrests for everything from drug promotion to assault.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mother Knows Best
programme.desc: Dog has two fugitives to catch, and he gets help from the unlikeliest sources - the fugitives' mothers. First, Ginger's mother wants to revoke her daughter's bond. Then, Brandon's mother decides to revoke his bond because Brandon has an ice habit.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Irons in the Fire
programme.desc: Dog is back hunting in the big city of Denver, but chasing fugitives on the mainland is more dangerous than ever. So Dog decides that the crew should get pepper-ball guns, which have much better range than pepper spray.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rocky Mountain Roundup
programme.desc: Dog decides to help two of his bondsmen buddies, Dave "Red" Widhelm and "Downtown" Bobby Brown. First up is Red, who has a client, named Alvin, whose bond is $20,000. Then the team goes after Craig, a client of Bobby's whose bond is almost $70,000.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: This One's For You
programme.desc: Dog leads the team on another adrenaline-filled chase in Denver. The fugitive, Robert, has a habit of address-hopping that makes him a difficult target, but Dog refuses to give up and finally tracks Robert down in his latest hideaway.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Baby Lyssa Steps Up
programme.desc: The team is still in Colorado, and today Dog starts his day by to giving his kids and crew a sample of their western heritage by taking them horseback riding. This hunt takes Dog back to his old stomping grounds in Denver.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Running on Empty
programme.desc: Dog's time is running out in Colorado. After a month of helping his bail bondsmen friends around Denver, he's got to get his family back home to Hawaii. But Dog wants one more capture before they leave.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Inside Out
programme.desc: Dog kickstarts the search for Jackson, a 240lbs, six feet tall bad boy who has skipped out on a $10,000 bond. Jackson’s apparently at his father-in-law's house, but the father-in-law has info about Jackson that brings Dog to a unique hideout.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Growing Up Is Hard To Do
programme.sub-title: Growing Up Is Hard To Do
programme.desc: With twelve kids of his own, Dog knows how hard it is to keep children on the straight and narrow, especially during their turbulent teens.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Year of the Dog
programme.desc: A one-hour special that looks back at 2006, one of Dog's most tumultuous years, which has included the passing of Beth's father, Dog and Beth's wedding, the tragic death of Dog's daughter Barbara.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Mystery of Mona Lisa
programme.desc: When Lyssa points out that the fugitive in the next case has the same birth date as Barbara, Dog's recently deceased daughter, the team takes a special vow to capture the young woman.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rusty Cuffs
programme.desc: Dog finds himself fighting two enemies; the law and his inner demons. He continues his legal battle to fight extradition to Mexico in connection with his 2003 capture of fugitive rapist Andrew Luster. His other struggle is private.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Make a Wish
programme.desc: Dog shows his love of justice and children in this poignant episode. He begins by giving encouragement to a group of handicapped children, then starting the search for Jacob, a fugitive who's abandoned his wife and children.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tough Love
programme.desc: Michael is out on bail for drug sales, theft, and violation of parole. Dog's after him for failing to appear in court and his only lead is Jen, his co-signer and girlfriend.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surprise Ending
programme.desc: Dog and the boys are going after a fugitive with a $25,000 bond and a string of theft charges behind him. When the team hits his apartment, they find a boot print on the door, a souvenir of a police raid from only days earlier?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Big Wipe-Out
programme.desc: A Hawaiian surfing hero is on a wave to nowhere and it's Dog's turn to play lifeguard. "Buttons," known throughout the islands for his prowess on the waves and his daring 360's, has wiped-out on the rocky shoals of drug addiction.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: You Can Bet On It!
programme.desc: Kristine had a string of gambling and forgery charges before she jumped bail leaving Dog "holding the bag". Now it's time for Dog to call in some chits of his own, getting the help of trusty informants he's helped out over the years.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fly Boy
programme.desc: Dog told him not to go, but Charles went anyway, skipping to Oregon against the terms of his bail. Now Dog has a tip that Charles plans to slip back into Honolulu. With $30,000 on the line Dog knows he can leave little to chance.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Guns & Ice
programme.desc: The following day is Dog's birthday but that won't stop him from chasing a fugitive, who is facing firearms charges. Dog doesn't relish the thought of going after an alleged gunslinger on his birthday but he's never one to avoid a challenge.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Good Fight
programme.desc: Dog and Beth have to be at the state capitol bright and early to receive an award for their fight against ice in Hawaii. Afterwards, they're inspired to start the hunt for Shanna, an alleged ice user and identity thief with $80,000 in bonds.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Smackdown of Baby Lyssa
programme.desc: After meeting with the cosigner on a bond for a man named John, Dog and the Posse hatch a plan to lure him to a high rise apartment. But when night falls, their plan leaves a member of the team alone and in harm's way!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Friend in Need
programme.desc: Roger has 27 prior arrests, spent years in jail and doesn't want to go back. But he's missed court and now Dog has to bring him in. To complicate matters, this fugitive lives in a tightly-knit community where good information won't come easy.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Your Lying Eyes
programme.desc: Kolani's on the run, left his wife to look after four kids and left Dog holding the bag for the $10k bond. So their pursuit on this case takes them into some parts of Ohau, and the human heart, that few of us will ever see.

programme.title: Scott Novotny
programme.desc: Scott Novotny brings his high-energy goofyness to the live audience at VidAngel Studios.

programme.title: David Dyer
programme.desc: David Dyer has been performing at stand-up at comedy clubs and corporate events for over twenty years. He's worked with some of the best comics in the industry including Mike Birbiglia, Jim Breuer, and Lewis Black. He's been a contributing writer to NBC's Late Night with Jimmy Fallon and ABC's Politically Incorrect. He's a regular on the nationally syndicated Bob and Tom Show and often appears on the roster for their “Friends of The Bob and Tom Show” comedy tour. He's the host of a new web series called Sidecar Sessions where he interviews guests who are sitting in the sidecar of his motorcycle as David pilots the bike around town. David also created and stars in another web series called Pillars with co-star, Kevin Yon. David became an on-call firefighter with Grand Rapids Township in Michigan….his wife is nervous.

programme.title: Thor Ramsey
programme.desc: Thor Ramsey's daily life is full of small decisions. With the application of metaphysics, quantum mechanics, and expiration dates. No decision—big or small—will ever feel right.

programme.title: Karen Rontowski
programme.desc: Karen Rontowski's fast-paced, quirky and charmingly optimistic comedy has been featured in clubs, TV, radio, and at corporate events all around the world. Her stand- up showcases endearing, self-effacing and intelligent characters that catch you by surprise every time. Karen uniquely blends comedy with her experience as a Paranormal Investigator and Reiki master. From fun with her family to her travels all over this great country Karen has fun where ever she goes. Her lighthearted confusion entertains kids of all ages. She is fascinated with the “afterlife” is convinced she will someday have a near death experience because, “I never finish anything.” She explains, “Sometimes a ghost will just do the same thing over and over in life. That's why I want to move into a house that is haunted by a maid." Karen's comedy is now featured in the new line of greeting cards called “Frank and Funny” sold at Target stores everywhere and is the comedy writer for “Haunted Magazine.” She is a regular on the Bob and Tom Radio Show and is a featured performer on their CD. Karen has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman, Sirius Satellite Radio, Comics Unleashed, Comedy.com, Live at Gotham and Comedy Central. She has opened for show biz legends including Bob Hope, Ray Charles, David Brenner and the Monkees.

programme.title: Andy Erikson
programme.desc: Andy intertwines silly one-liners with whimsical stories in a playful but thought-provoking way.

programme.title: Rob Little: Ado-Rob-Ble
programme.desc: Rob Little's outlook on life can be summed up in two words: Pure Optimism. In a recent interview he revealed, "In elementary school, kids would always pull food away from me at lunchtime saying mean, hurtful things like " 'Let go of my sandwich!'"

programme.title: Scotty K.: Not Country Music
programme.desc: Scotty K proves that he is a jack of all trades, or at least of two: the guitar and comedy. In this set, Scotty refers to everything from Rascal Flatts to Stretch Armstrong. If you miss the "good old days," this is sure to take you back!

programme.title: XTERRA Adventures
programme.desc: S01E04 XTERRA is the world's premier off-road multisport event. An extreme competition, the XTERRA format combines swimming with mountain biking and trail running. It has been described as one part triathlon, one part mountain bike race, and one part "survival of the fittest". The typical distances are a 1.5k swim, 30k mountain bike, and 10k trail run.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E05 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E03 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.desc: Cleo discovers a comet is causing fish to flee the waters around Mako Island. The girls find a way to restart the message in the Moon Pool and discover the comet will collide with earth.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Graduation
programme.desc: Sophie and Ryan damage the Moon Pool in their efforts to obtain the rare crystals. The girls improvise and use their own magic to prevent the impact of the comet and a planet wide catastrophe. Rikki, Cleo and Bella graduate with a surprise.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Cleo and Emma meet new girl, Rikki, and find themselves stuck on Mako Island where they are transformed into mermaids. As well as growing tails, the girls find they have powers over water.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Annoying Miss Popularity, Miriam, is having a pool party and the girls want to go. But being around water is risky, especially when Zane tosses Cleo into the pool. Lewis is the only one around to help so he finds out their secret.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Rikki, Emma and Cleo discover that sea turtles are being captured by fishing nets. When Rikki and Emma attempt to rescue the turtles by cutting the nets, it causes the fisherman to think that there is a rogue shark roaming their ocean.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Emma decides that she is not going to have her annual sleepover party due to what has happened to them. But Rikki and Cleo try to convince her otherwise. Meanwhile, Lewis conducts experiments on the girls.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Cleo's sister Kim finds her diary and thinks that Cleo and her friends are 'evil mermaids' and she plans to tell everyone. Meanwhile, Lewis goes to Mako Island to find out more about what happened to the girls.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Rikki gains an admirer in Emma’s younger brother Elliot when she saves him from drowning. She lets him down hard causing him to run away and hide in the fernery. The girls find him just as the watering system is about to start…

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: The effects of the full moon turns Emma into a carefree, wild mermaid. At her father’s birthday party she’s the opposite to her usual, organised self. Can the other girls stop her before all is revealed?

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: A charismatic newcomer, Dr. Denman, tempts Lewis with the promise of scientific fame and fortune. Will he abandon his friends and risk their secret, all in the name of science?

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Rikki uses her abilities as a mermaid to earn some quick cash, but when she accidentally becomes involved in a fish smuggling operation, she sets out to get her revenge.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Rikki enters a short film contest on the theme of 'Heroes' and decides to capture some nice underwater footage with her 'abilities'. Meanwhile, Emma is interviewing her mum and Zane and Lewis are planning to rennact Dr. Bennet's windsurfing record.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Byron asks Emma for help with training the school's swimming team and Emma has some trouble deciding whether or not to help out in her current situation. Meanwhile, Lewis continues to experiment on the girls, which annoys Rikki.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: When the mysterious, old Miss Chatham's boat and home is declared unseaworthy, Emma invites her over to stay. Zane gets trapped on the sinking boat and Emma tries to save him but he sees a tail.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Cleo's 16th birthday is approaching and she thinks that her father is going to throw another embarrasing birthday party. Meanwhile, Zane tries to find the 'sea monster' that he saw when he almost drowned.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Emma is put in charge of managing the juice bar. Miriam decides to cause trouble and cuts the power to the cool room, then is unwittingly frozen by Emma who uses her powers to fix the freezer. Will the girls be able to thaw Miriam out?

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to play sick, the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Lewis enters the annual fishing derby. When Cleo sees him struggling, she decides to help him out with disastorous consequnces. Meanwhile, Rikki and Zane are trapped on a hotel balcony.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: iCarly: Schluss mit lustig – Teil 2
programme.desc: Bei iCarly ist ein ziemlich cooles Video eingetrudelt. Die Macher heißen Fleck und Dave und sind obendrein auch noch sehr witzig, weswegen Carly und Sam sie in die Show einladen.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby flippt aus
programme.desc: Tasha, Gibbys Freundin, bittet Freddie um einen Ratschlag, da sie Gibby eine Videokamera zum Geburtstag schenken möchte. Als die beiden deshalb alleine oben im iCarly Studio sind, stolpert Tasha und fällt auf Freddie.

programme.title: iCarly: Alte Liebe, neuer Horror
programme.desc: Sam findet im Büro des Portiers Lewbert eine Kiste mit persönlichen Gegenständen. Als sie diese zusammen mit Carly und Freddie durchstöbert, finden die Drei eine romantische DVD, die von Lewberts Ex-Freundin Marta erstellt wurde.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Teen Seattle
programme.desc: Sam outet sich als ehemalige Teilnehmerin bei Misswahlen. Um zu verhindern, dass ihre frühere Widersacherin Leanne Carter die hundertste Misswahl in Folge gewinnt, simuliert Sam einen Wutanfall und zwingt Carly dazu, bei der Wahl zur Miss Teen.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly für Daddy
programme.desc: Sam hat einem Diplomaten einen Chilidog in die Hose gestopft und landet im Knast. Doch Carly will die wöchentliche iCarly auf keinen Fall absagen, da ihr Vater zum ersten Mal live zugucken kann. Sie überredet Spencer, für Sam einzuspringen.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly im All
programme.desc: Mr. Blanton, ein stinkreicher Mann, bietet iCarly die Möglichkeit, ins All zu fliegen. Sie sollen von dort aus eine Webshow senden. Doch zuvor müssen sie ein Trainingswochenende absolvieren und ihre Konkurrenten, eine Fitnessshow, aus dem Weg räumen.

programme.title: iCarly: Bigfoot und Waschbiber
programme.desc: In einem Nationalpark wird immer wieder der sagenumwobene Bigfoot gesichtet. Carly glaubt fest daran, dass es ihn wirklich gibt, aber die anderen sind eher misstrauisch.

programme.title: iCarly: iPsycho – Teil 2
programme.desc: Die 'iCarly'-Truppe beschließt auf dem Weg zu einer Web-Konferenz, einen kurzen Abstecher zum Geburtstag eines einsamen Fans zu machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Pleiten, Pech und Patzer
programme.desc: In dieser Folge gibt es die besten Outtakes, Versprecher, Patzer und Lachanfälle aus 70 Folgen 'iCarly'!

programme.title: iCarly: Hurra, hurra, die Bude brennt!
programme.desc: Spencer versucht, Carly an ihrem Geburtstag zu überraschen, aber stattdessen setzt er ihr Zimmer in Brand. Doch als ihm die Versicherungsfirma einen dicken Scheck aushändigt, hat er die Chance, alles wiedergutzumachen.

programme.title: iCarly: Ja, ich will
programme.desc: Als ein Fan von iCarly seiner Freundin in der Web-Show live einen Heiratsantrag macht, erklärt sich die Truppe bereit, zur Hochzeit zu erscheinen. Doch als die Braut kalte Füße bekommt, muss Carly den Tag retten.

programme.title: iCarly: Penny-Tees
programme.desc: Die Truppe steigt ins T-Shirt-Geschäft ein. Als die Penny-Tees zum Verkaufsschlager werden, rekrutiert Sam Viertklässler, die bei der Herstellung der Shirts helfen sollen. Doch Carly, Sam und Freddie streiten sich wegen der Arbeitsbedingungen.

programme.title: iCarly: Der König der Streiche
programme.desc: Carly gesteht, dass sie noch nie im Leben jemandem einen Streich gespielt hat. Um zu beweisen, dass sie es dennoch kann, bittet sie Spencer um Hilfe. Doch der hat damit ein gewaltiges Problem.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Mom
programme.desc: Nach einem Streit mit ihrer Mutter zieht Sam bei Carly ein. Aber Carly merkt schon bald, dass Sam ein schrecklicher Gast ist. Freddie wird von einem gefährlichen Kriminellen gestalkt, nachdem er ihn bei einem Verbrechen gefilmt hat.

programme.title: iCarly: Armer Nevel
programme.desc: Als ein Video von Nevel im Internet kursiert, in dem er ein kleines Mädchen zur Schnecke macht, wird er zum Hassobjekt der Leute. Er fleht Carly und ihre Gang darum an, seine Ehre wieder herzustellen – und die lassen sich tatsächlich dazu erweichen.

programme.title: iCarly: Zu doof, um wahr zu sein
programme.sub-title: Zu doof, um wahr zu sein
programme.desc: Carly und Co. wollen ein wenig von der vielen Arbeit abtreten und suchen deshalb nach Praktikanten. Bei der Vorstellungsrunde tut sich besonders ein vielversprechender Nerd hervor.

programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Doch als dieser sie endlich zu einem Date einlädt, muss sie schockiert feststellen, dass ausgerechnet zu dieser Zeit ein großer 'iCarly'-Auftritt auf einer Comic-Messe ansteht.

programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Als Carly dann Adam dazu einlädt, sie auf eine Comic-Messe zu begleiten, ahnt sie allerdings noch nicht, dass sie in einen äußerst peinlichen Fan-Krieg verwickelt werden wird.

programme.title: iCarly: Und zum Schluss ein Kuss
programme.desc: Carly und ihre Freunde verbringen eine Nacht in der Schule, um ihre Schulprojekte abzuschliessen. Dabei glauben Carly und Freddie, dass sich Sam möglicherweise in den neuen Jungen namens Brad verknallt haben könnte.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 3
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: Es gibt Zoff!
programme.desc: Carly muss ständig zwischen Freddie und Sam vermitteln.

programme.title: iCarly: Die Liebe und der Wahnsinn
programme.desc: Carly findet heraus, dass Sam sich in eine Nervenheilanstalt hat einweisen lassen, weil sie glaubt, wegen ihrer Sympathie für Freddie verrückt zu sein. Da sie nicht aus der Anstalt herauskann, fragt sich die Gang, wie sie sie herausbekommen.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Nerd-Camp
programme.desc: Als Gibby einen Plan ausheckt, um Sam und Freddie zu trennen, deckt Mrs. Benson deren Beziehung auf. Wird sich Carly für Sam und Freddie einsetzen oder Gibby dabei helfen, sie auseinander zu bringen?

programme.title: iCarly: Zu dumm
programme.desc: Carly will ihren neuen Schwarm damit beeindrucken, indem sie sich schlauer gibt als sie eigentlich ist. Währenddessen hilft der Rest der Truppe T-Bo dabei, ein neues zu Hause zu finden, weil er aus dem 'Groovy Smoothie' geschmissen wurde.

programme.title: iCarly: Besuch der First Lady
programme.desc: Die Kids wollen Carlys Vater eine Online-Geburtstagsparty schmeißen. Doch als sie sich in ein gesichertes Netzwerk einhacken, bekommen sie Ärger von einer wichtigen Informationsagentur des Landes.

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 1
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Kids erfahren, dass Nora Dershlit aus dem Knast freikommen soll. Was können sie tun, damit ihre ehemalige Peinigerin hinter Gittern bleibt?

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 2
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang muss einen Weg finden, vor Nora und ihren verrückten Eltern zu fliehen.

programme.title: iCarly: Im Butterkuchen-Himmel
programme.desc: Alle außer Carly gehen zur Kanadischen Kuchenfabrik, doch Sam darf nicht wieder in die USA einreisen. Unterdessen macht sich Carly ausgehfertig für ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Oh weh, 3D!
programme.desc: Freddie will seine kreative Seite spielen lassen und entscheidet sich iCarly in 3D zu senden. Spencer stellt einen Assistenten an, den er nicht bezahlen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.sub-title: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, der bei 'Victorious' den Charakter 'Rex' spielt, interviewt die Stars von iCarly und zeigt die besten Outtakes der Staffel.

programme.title: iCarly: Action mit One Direction
programme.desc: Nach einem Urlaub hat sich Carly eine ansteckende Krankheit eingefangen. Leider steckt sie ein Mitglied der Band One Direction an. Spencer soll mit einem kleinen Mädchen trainieren, das keine Lust hat Sport zu treiben.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibbys Traum
programme.desc: Mithilfe von Sam eröffnet Gibby im Keller der Schule ein geheimes Restaurant. Unterdessen designt Spencer einen Sicherheitsroboter fürs Loft. Doch der Roboter spielt plötzlich verrückt!

programme.title: iCarly: April, April ...
programme.desc: Es ist der 1. April! Carly und Spencer sollen aus ihrer Wohnung zwangsgeräumt werden, also teilen die Freunde ihre gemeinsamen Erlebnisse in der Wohnung. Doch wir erinnern uns etwas anders.

programme.desc: Charley, crippled by Parvo, may never walk again. Charley’s nurse uses everything she can to get Charley back to his family, including play therapy, exercise, and a souped-up walker.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Junkyard"
programme.desc: The North Shore Animal League must tame and groom Shooter, a wild dog discovered in a junkyard in the Bronx, so that he may graduate from junkyard dog to family pet.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Five Puppies"
programme.desc: An emaciated and sick dog named Shy must regain her strength and her spirit to cope with an upcoming PR campaign to get her – and her five pups - adopted.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "New York City Strays"
programme.desc: The future of eight puppies and their stray mother found on the streets of New York City depends on the North Shore Animal league staff, who must decide if the strays are adoptable.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Sadie"
programme.desc: Sadie will need therapy to get over the trauma she suffered at the hands of an abusive owner. The North Shore Animal League staff work diligently to restore Sadie’s trust in humans, so that a more loving family can adopt her.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Save Cuddles"
programme.desc: The North Shore Animal League team work to save Cuddles, a scruffy terrier mix who was hit by a car and can no longer walk, and Heather, a dog with a behaviour problem. But the staff can’t guarantee miracles for either of them.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Runway Pups"
programme.desc: At the League’s public relations department, Marge Stein has her hands full planning a fundraising lunch.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Kevin and Cujo"
programme.desc: Isabelle Hamel, a North Shore Animal League trainer, teaches Cujo and his sixteen year-old owner a new set of behaviour tricks. But if Kevin and Cujo don’t take the training seriously, they may end up separated permanently.

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Snowstorm"
programme.desc: At the North Shore Animal League the cages are full, and a snowstorm may keep potential adopters away. Crowded cages also put extra pressure on the staff, who need to work extra hours to care for all the animals.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Meet the NJ Team"
programme.desc: Penny the Doberman gets a prosthetic that transforms her life, while Jeter the Rottweiler finally walks again with a brace made just for him.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "A Noble Cause"
programme.desc: Rescue Bully Noble gets a brace to rejoin his owner on the trails, while German Shepherd Khloe fights for her future after injuring both front legs.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Buddies Reunite"
programme.desc: Granite, a Staffordshire Terrier gets a new brace, while Clayton visits his favorite rescue and shares a touching reunion with an old friend.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Tug On My Heart"
programme.desc: Jackson, a white Golden puppy, gets a last-minute chance to save his leg, while senior farm dog Tug finds hope and a second chance at life.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Dog Daze"
programme.desc: Draper, born with amniotic band syndrome, gets a front-paw prosthetic. Molly the rescued Pitbull needs a knee brace after getting hurt playing.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Smell the Rosies"
programme.desc: Rosie the Pug, rescued from China, gets a new prosthetic with Katie’s help. Bailey the Lab gets a brace so she can keep enjoying her walks.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Back to LaMancha"
programme.desc: Axl Rose, a Lab mix, injures another leg and turns to a brace for help. Clayton visits LaMancha to check in on Rylie, a Schnauzer mix he once treated.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Barking Up the Right Tree"
programme.desc: Harley Quinn gets a brace as she starts life with a new owner after a tragic accident. Rover also needs support after a jump leaves him injured.

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "One Cool Cat"

programme.title: Second Chance Pets S2 - "Act of Valor"

Amazing Animal Friends S1E5 -Creature Comforts

programme.desc: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the region’s delicate living networks.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E7 -Cambodia: Hidden Refuges
programme.desc: Bisected by the Mekong’s mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E8 -Cambodia: Seasonal Cycles
programme.desc: The Mekong is Cambodia’s lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E9 -Vietnam: Life in the Delta
programme.desc: The final country on the Mekong’s journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnam’s crown, a biological treasure trove.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E10 -Vietnam: the Journey's End
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.title: Humanlike: The Chimps of Fongoli S1E1

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School S3E1 -Back to School

programme.title: Hum Dekhengay
programme.desc: News show hosted by Mansoor Ali Khan, encapsulating the most headline-worthy & important stories of the day with analytical backgrounds and relevant analysis.

programme.title: Money Gang Lit
programme.desc: Hakeem Benson, a down-on-his-luck videographer, is evicted and adrift. He takes a risky music video gig for Bull Dawg, a notorious kingpin. But when a respected gang member is murdered, Hakeem is falsely accused and targeted. Now, in a city on fire, he's fighting for his life and meaning amidst the chaos.

programme.title: Who is She
programme.desc: Megan is a beautiful woman in search of love and acceptance but masks a tormented soul. Beneath the surface lies a volatile woman with multiple personalities and a dangerous capacity for violence.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Scandalous
programme.desc: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

programme.title: CODE
programme.desc: Dallas artist MALIK SCHAEFER, also known as CODE, is a rising star in the underground rap scene. Although his checkered past has led him down the wrong road at times, with the help of his best friend, STYLES, Malik is back on the fast-track to success. That is, until he reconnects with the dangerous love of his life, SOPHIA ORTEGA, who threatens to destroy it all. Malik must decide to either follow his heart or live by the code that has served him well for many years: family over everything.

programme.title: Trap A Fool
programme.desc: After two years of what he thought was a perfect relationship, Jeremiah uncovers his beloved Shay-Shay's "black book" of men. He is forced to realize that her gentle nature was a facade, a calculated move in her "game of fools." Shay-Shay's only loves are herself, sex, and money, and their dangerous game is about to end.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Single Black Female
programme.desc: Rose is a young college freshman who meets her roommate Max for the first time. The two develop an intense bond, and Max is willing to prove her loyalty to Rose, even if it means someone will have to die if they get in the way.

programme.title: Aliens in the Hood
programme.desc: The hood politics of the neighborhood become even more complicated after the arrival of aliens! When one man in the neighborhood is blessed with superpowers, he and the other warring factions are headed to war over control of the current drug trade.

programme.title: Toxic King
programme.desc: Keeng is searching for love in all the wrong places. After years of trouble relationships, he decides to just be a playboy and become a “serial love hopper” that is until he reunites with Zuri, a college friend who he has always had a crush on. Will he fight for true love? Or resign to being a Toxic King?

programme.title: Love and Deceit 2
programme.desc: Carolyn, a successful businesswoman moves to a new town in hopes of laying down some roots after her divorce. She joins a local women’s group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality, she’s there to rekindle an old flame with a former lover, who happens to be Beverly’s husband.

programme.title: Art of Murder
programme.desc: Detectives Trent Rollins and Latoya Cooper investigate a series of murders in which the victims all bear a mysterious symbol that’s connected to a previous murder of a known artist, Preston Sacher. As they close in, Rollins finds himself stuck between protecting his family, and doing what’s right.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
programme.desc: When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City, MO. After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler
programme.desc: Three childhood friends, Lala, Binky, and Jay grew up together on the streets of East Baltimore. Wanting a better life for themselves, they learn the ways of hustling. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: The Offer
programme.desc: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision. As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: Till Lies Do Us Part
programme.desc: Amina and Alex announce their engagement to their family and friends after only dating for six months, and are having a destination wedding at that. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface causing chaos and drama.

programme.title: Garrett Morris and Michael Schultz
programme.desc: The story of the careers of legendary actor Garrett Morrison and legendary movie director Michael Schultz. Follow their life and career from their early beginnings to adulthood and becoming worldwide legendary artists from Broadway to Hollywood.

programme.desc: Bunks and the showers are a mad stabber's beat at a summer camp strictly for teens.

programme.desc: A dangerous cult leader and his henchmen resume a grisly murder spree following their release from prison.
