programme.title: X
programme.desc: 1979 plant eine Gruppe junger Filmemacher, einen Sexstreifen in Texas zu drehen. Der Porno trägt den Titel "The Farmer's Daughters", weshalb die Handlung auf einem einsam gelegenen Bauernhof spielt. Als Maxine (Mia Goth), Jackson (Kid Cudi) und die anderen mit den ersten wilden Sexszenen loslegen, ist das Schicksal der jungen Leute bereits besiegelt. Denn was niemand der Filmcrew geahnt hat: Das schrullige Gastgeber-Ehepaar hat auf seine alten Tage eine bizarre Mordlust entwickelt! - Der Independent-Film von Ti West erhielt u.a. Nominierungen für den Chainsaw- und den Saturn Award ("Best Horror Movie").

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Die Abrechnung - Hercules wird auf eine harte Probe gestellt. Nun, da seine übernatürlichen Kräfte verloren sind, ist der Halbgott dem Zorn seiner Widersacher schutzlos ausgeliefert. Als Strife (Joel Tobeck), der Neffe von Kriegsgott Ares, behauptet, Hercules habe seine Ehefrau Serena ermordet, eskaliert die Situation. Neben feindseligen Göttern hat es jetzt auch ein wütender Mob aus dem Dorf Cyrenia auf den trauernden Witwer abgesehen! Xena, Gabrielle (Renée O'Connor), Iolaus und sogar Zeus (Peter Vere-Jones) stehen Hercules in der schweren Zeit zur Seite, damit die Wahrheit über das perfide Mordkomplott ans Licht kommt.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Die unterirdische Stadt - Iolaus und seine Gefährtin Moria (Fiona Mogridge) stoßen auf ein düsteres Geheimnis. Offenbar hat der betrügerische Sektenführer Kamaros (Matthew Chamberlain) Männer und Frauen um sich geschart, um für ihn nach Gold zu schürfen. Auch Salmoneus und Iolaus' verschollene Cousine Regina (Amber Sainsbury) sind in den Dunstkreis des manipulativen Gurus geraten. Als herauskommt, dass Kamaros sogar Drogen einsetzt, damit die Gehirnwäsche funktioniert, ziehen Iolaus und Moria alle Register. Sie mischen den Sektenführer und seine Schergen auf und befreien den Untergrundkult aus der Sklaverei.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Im Namen der Gerechtigkeit - Frankreich, 1789: Die Banditen Robert (Kevin Sorbo) und Jean-Pierre (Michael Hurst) lassen keine Gelegenheit aus, wenn es darum geht, etwas dazu zu verdienen. Auch Francois (Robert Trebor) und dessen Angebetete, die Aristokratin Marie DeValle (Danielle Cormack), geraten ins Visier des gewieften Duos. Aber bei diesem historisch angehauchten Versteckspiel ist nichts, wie es scheint: Denn hinter den Kulissen zieht ein geheimnisvoller Freiheitskämpfer, Deckname "der Fuchs", die Strippen. Als die Tarnung des Phantoms auffliegt, und Marie mit der Guillotine hingerichtet werden soll, schreiten die Gauner zur Tat...

programme.title: Xena
programme.desc: Karmische Katastrophen - Die Kriegerprinzessin Xena (Lucy Lawless) hat böswilligen Göttern und herrschsüchtigen Warlords den Kampf angesagt. In einer antiken Welt voller Mythen und Legenden setzt sich die furchtlose Fighterin für das Gute ein. Zusammen mit ihrer besten Freundin Gabrielle (Renée O'Connor) beschützt Xena die Schwachen und befreit die Unterdrückten. Bei dem Abenteuer, das von Griechenland über Persien bis ins Land der aufgehenden Sonne führt, muss sich Xena oft mit ihrer eigenen Vergangenheit auseinandersetzen. Denn Kriegsgott Ares (Kevin Smith) lässt nichts unversucht, seine einstige Schülerin zurück auf die dunkle Seite zu ziehen. - Zeitloser Fantasy-Klassiker aus den 1990er-Jahren.

programme.title: Spooky Night - Nachts im Horrorladen
programme.desc: Pünktlich zu Halloween haben Bo (Jaiden J. Smith), Carson (Dylan Martin Frankel) und Jake (Donovan Colan) etwas ganz Besonderes vor. Die drei Schulfreunde lassen sich über Nacht in einem "Spirit Halloween"-Shop einsperren! Auch Carsons Schwester Kate (Marissa Reyes) stößt später dazu. Doch das freche Teenie-Abenteuer mutiert schnell zu einem echten Albtraum. Was die Freunde nicht wissen: Der Horrorladen ist total verhext, und zwischen den Grusel-Accessoires lauert ein mies gelaunter Geist. - Das Drehbuch des spaßigen Jugend-Horrorfilms stammt aus der Feder von Filmemacherin Billie Bates.

programme.title: Action Heroes
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves - Hollywoodstar Keanu Reeves wurde in Beirut geboren und ist in Toronto aufgewachsen. Der Actionthriller "Speed" machte ihn weltbekannt. Für seine Rolle als Neo im Filmepos "Matrix" wurde Reeves mit dem Blockbuster Entertainment Award ausgezeichnet.

Bei dem Abenteuer, das von Griechenland über Persien bis ins Land der aufgehenden Sonne führt, muss sich Xena oft mit ihrer eigenen Vergangenheit auseinandersetzen. Denn Kriegsgott Ares (Kevin Smith) lässt nichts unversucht, seine einstige Schülerin zurück auf die dunkle Seite zu ziehen. - Zeitloser Fantasy-Klassiker aus den 1990er-Jahren.

programme.title: Star Trek: Legenden
programme.desc: Wie ich Chekov wurde - Exklusive Interviews mit Erinnerungen, Anekdoten und Denkanstößen von Star-Trek-Legenden wie William "James T. Kirk" Shatner, Jonathan "William T. Ryker" Frakes oder Marina "Deanna Troi" Sirtis. Auch "Dr. Trek", Larry Nemecek, Walter Koenig alias Pavel Chekov, "Q"-Darsteller John de Lancie und Eugene Roddenberry, Sohn von STAR TREK-Schöpfer Gene Roddenberry, geben Einblicke in die bewegte Geschichte von STAR TREK und ordnen die Serien nicht nur im medialen, sondern auch im gesellschaftlichen Kontext ein.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Tötet den Mond - 2049 steht die Welt kurz davor, den Mond in die Luft zu jagen. Da die Masse des Erdtrabanten stark zugenommen hat, kommt es zu tödlichen Flutwellen. Der Doktor und Clara fliegen mit dem Space Shuttle von Captain Lundvik (Hermione Norris) zum Mond, wobei sie einige erschreckende Entdeckungen machen. Die Astronaut:innen befinden sich auf einer Selbstmordmission: Sie sollen den lästigen Himmelskörper mit Atombomben pulverisieren! Bei näherer Betrachtung kommt zudem heraus, dass es sich beim Mond in Wahrheit um ein gigantisches Ei handelt. Aber welche Kreatur wird hier in Kürze schlüpfen? Und was bedeutet das für die Zukunft der Menschheit?

programme.title: Star Trek: Legenden
programme.desc: Arbeiten mit Patrick Stewart - Exklusive Interviews mit Erinnerungen, Anekdoten und Denkanstößen von Star-Trek-Legenden wie William "James T. Kirk" Shatner, Jonathan "William T. Ryker" Frakes oder Marina "Deanna Troi" Sirtis. programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Die Mumie - Als der Timelord und Clara eine interstellare Zugreise antreten, müssen sie eine Reihe rätselhafter Todesfälle aufklären. Die Passagiere im kosmischen Orient-Express werden von einer unsichtbaren Mumie attackiert. Wer die grausige Kreatur erblickt, stirbt exakt in 66 Sekunden! Der Doktor findet heraus, dass es sich bei der Mumie um eine sagenumwobene Entität handelt, die auch als "Prophezeiung" bezeichnet wird. Weitere Detektivarbeit im Weltraumzug bringt ans Licht, dass die Mumie in Wahrheit ein untoter Soldat aus der Zukunft ist, der zum Morden verdammt wurde und futuristische Technologien einsetzt.

programme.title: 2021 War of the Worlds: Invasion from Mars
programme.desc: Angriff auf die Erde: Als eine feindselige Alien-Zivilisation vom Mars aus den Planeten ansteuert, ist es bereits zu spät. Zunächst wird die internationale Raumstation ISS per Laserstrahl zerstört. Danach ist New York City dran. Die Außerirdischen sind monströse Wesen und verfügen über futuristische Technologien. Während die US-Streitkräfte unter dem Kommando von General Reed (Tom Sizemore) zum Gegenschlag ausholen, suchen Astroforscherin Dr. Allison Fischer (Emily Killian) und ihr Bruder Henry (Anthony Jensen) nach alternativen Methoden der Alienbekämpfung. - Science-Fiction-Endzeit-Thriller mit jeder Menge CGI. Regie führte Mario N. Bonassin. Das Drehbuch stammt von Joe Roche.

programme.title: Der City Hai
programme.desc: Mark Kaminsky (Arnold Schwarzenegger) fristet sein Dasein als Sheriff in einer Kleinstadt, seit er sich mit seiner brutalen Art als FBI-Agent selbst ins Aus geschossen hat. Doch dann braucht ihn Chicago: Die Mafia hat überhandgenommen und sogar den Sohn seines früheren Kollegen Shannon (Darren McGavin) getötet. Jetzt darf Kaminsky wieder ran. - Der Film überrascht mit kleinen Ähnlichkeiten und Anspielungen auf andere Schwarzenegger-Filme: zum Beispiel trägt Baker, der Charakter von Robert Davi, in "Der City Hai" die Sonnenbrille, die Schwarzenegger in "Terminator" aufhatte. Auch das typische Schwarzenegger-"I'll be back" ist wieder enthalten.

programme.title: D-Tox - Im Auge der Angst
programme.desc: FBI-Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) ist der Alkoholsucht verfallen. Der Grund? Ein Serienkiller hat mehrere Kollegen, und nun auch Jakes Freundin, bestialisch ermordet. Der Versuch, die traumatischen Ereignisse zu verarbeiten, führt Malloy schließlich in eine Nervenheilanstalt für Beamte in Wyoming. Dort bekommt er seelische Unterstützung von Dr. John Mitchell (Kris Kristofferson) und Psychotherapeutin Jenny Munroe (Polly Walker). Doch als der Gebäudekomplex durch einen Schneesturm von der Außenwelt abgeschnitten wird, gehen die Morde plötzlich innerhalb der Klinik weiter. - Psychothriller mit Sylvester Stallone als (Anti-)Held in der Hauptrolle. Der Film basiert auf dem Roman ...

programme.title: The Intergalactic Adventures of Max Cloud
programme.desc: Brooklyn, 1990: Als Sarah (Isabelle Allen) Videospielverbot für das ganze Wochenende erteilt bekommt, bricht für das Mädchen die Welt zusammen. Doch ehe Sarah sich versieht, findet sie sich in der virtuellen Realität ihres Lieblings-Videospiels wieder. Nun muss die junge Gamerin Seite an Seite mit dem Weltraumhelden Max Cloud (Scott Adkins) und dessen Crew gegen übermächtige Space-Schurken antreten, die in einem intergalaktischen Gefängnis einsitzen. Aber nur, wenn es Sarahs Kumpel Cowboy (Franz Drameh) zuhause an der Konsole gelingt, die schlimmsten Verbrecher des Universums auszuknipsen, hat das Zocker-Girl eine Chance auf Heimkehr. - Sciencefiction-Actionkomödie von Regisseur Martin Owen.

programme.title: Eden Lake
programme.desc: Ein schöner See, herrliche Natur und ein romantisches Stelldichein. Kindergärtnerin Jenny (Kelly Reilly) und ihr Freund Steve (Michael Fassbender) wollen sich und die Ruhe fernab des hektischen Londons allein genießen. Der Haufen lauter Jugendlicher, der neben ihnen Platz nimmt, stört da erheblich. Vor allem der Anführer der Clique Brett (Jack O'Connell) scheint auf Krawall aus zu sein. Erste Konflikte lassen nicht lange auf sich warten. Die Eskalation auch nicht. Brutaler Horror-Thriller, malerisch in der englischen Grafschaft Buckinghamshire inszeniert.

programme.title: Arabellas Crime Time - Verbrechen im Visier
programme.desc: Who Let the Dogs Out? - Ein Passant beobachtet, wie eine Frau in ein Auto gezerrt wird. Er will helfen, doch der Angreifer zieht eine Waffe und schießt - aber die Pistole hat eine Ladehemmung. "Arabellas Crime Time" zeigt dramatische Geschichten hinter schockierenden Verbrechen, die viral gehen. Von Profi-Überwachungsgeräten bis hin zu Handycams - fast immer schaut jemand zu. Atemberaubende Clips von Entführungen, Einbrüchen, Verfolgungsjagden und anderen Gewaltverbrechen bringen Millionen von Views ein. Doch diese Doku-Serie geht über das spannende Filmmaterial hinaus, um die ganze Geschichte zu erzählen. Präsentiert werden die Fälle von Moderatorin Arabella Kiesbauer.

programme.title: Action Directors
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese - Martin Scorcese gehört zu den ganz Großen im Filmgeschäft. Der Oscarpreisträger mischt seit über 60 Jahren in Hollywood mit und hat das Publikum mit epischen Werken wie "Taxi Driver", "GoodFellas" oder "Gangs of New York" beglückt.

programme.title: Action Heroes
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal - Ob in "Brokeback Mountain", "Prince of Persia" oder "Nightcrawler": Jake Gyllenhaal ist ein extrem vielseitiger Schauspieler. Er hat höchst unterschiedliche Charaktere in verschiedenen Genres verkörpert.

programme.title: Joyce Meyer - Das Leben genießen
programme.desc: Joyce Meyer - Das Leben genießen - Heute: Angst vor Veränderung? Warum Aufbruch Heilung bringt Mit ihrer direkten, humorvollen und zugleich tiefgründigen Art vermittelt die US¿amerikanische Autorin und Bibellehrerin Joyce Meyer alltagsnahe Impulse, die Glauben und Leben miteinander verbinden. In ihren praxisorientierten Botschaften zeigt sie, wie biblische Prinzipien helfen können, Herausforderungen zu meistern, innere Freiheit zu finden und eine neue Haltung zum eigenen Alltag zu entwickeln. Millionen Menschen schätzen ihre authentische, klare Sprache und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich auf den Punkt zu bringen. Die Sendung bietet inspirierende Denkanstöße, die Mut machen und zu persönlicher Veränderung einladen.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: 1969 - Das Stargate, aufgebaut in einem geheimen US-Militärkomplex, ist das Relikt einer uralten Zivilisation. Über dieses Tor gelangt man sekundenschnell zu unzähligen anderen Planeten, auf denen sich weitere Stargates befinden. Das Team von Colonel Jack O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) hat die Aufgabe, über diese besonderen Alltransfers Kontakte zu anderen Zivilisationen zu knüpfen und die Erde gegen Angriffe von außen zu schützen, aber auch die Entstehung des Lebens und Lebensformen auf fremden Planeten zu erforschen. - Die Serie basiert auf Roland Emmerichs gleichnamigem Kinofilm (1994) und setzt dessen Handlung direkt fort.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Aurora - Das legendäre Atlantis existiert tatsächlich! Ein internationales Team aus Wissenschaftlern und Militärs auf der Erde hat eine sensationelle Entdeckung zu verbuchen: Im ewigen Eis der Antarktis findet es ein Tor zu einer neuen Welt. Durch das neue Stargate, ein Sternentor, gelangt ein Forschertrupp zur Pegasus Galaxie, wo sich die legendäre Stadt Atlantis befinden soll. Die gefährliche Mission führt das Atlantis-Team weit hinein ins Universum - weiter, als jemals zuvor ein Mensch gewesen ist. - Spin-off der Fernsehserie Stargate SG-1, welches ebenso wie das Original von Showrunner Brad Wright erdachte wurde.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Ruf der Wildnis - Bäume, soweit das Auge reicht: Der Doktor, Clara und Danny staunen nicht schlecht, als sie in einer Welt erwachen, die von urwüchsigen Wäldern überzogen ist. Auch Claras Schülerin Maebh (Abigail Eames) scheint etwas mit dem globalen botanischen Phänomen zu tun zu haben. Schließlich finden der Doktor und seine Freunde heraus, dass die vermeintliche grüne Hölle in Wahrheit ein Schutzmechanismus der Biosphäre ist: Das üppige Pflanzenwachstum soll die Erde und ihre Bewohner:innen vor den Auswirkungen einer schweren Sonneneruption bewahren. Auch in der Vergangenheit wurde so bereits apokalyptisches Unheil vom Planeten abgewendet.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Dunkles Wasser - Als Danny bei einem Unfall stirbt, nutzen Clara und der Doktor die telepathische Schnittstelle der TARDIS, um ihm ins Jenseits zu folgen. Die Spur führt über das 3W-Institut mitten ins "gelobte Land". Die Skelette der Toten werden in einer dunklen Flüssigkeit aufbewahrt. Auch Cyberman-Technologie ist bei der Konservierung im Spiel. Offenbar besteht das vermeintliche Paradies aus einer ewigen Sphäre, die in Wahrheit ein Matrix-Datenprozessor ist. Der Doktor lernt zudem Missy, die Chefin an der Himmelspforte, kennen. Sie gehört selbst zur Gattung der Timelords und ist die weibliche Inkarnation des Masters.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: Wetterveränderung - 6 Jahre, 9 Monate und 26 Tage ist es her, seit der "Snowpiercer" seine Fahrt um die Erde begonnen hat. Draußen herrscht eine tödliche Eiszeit, die durch fehlgeschlagene Wettermanipulation ausgelöst worden ist. Aber auch im Inneren des monströsen Zugs gibt es gravierende Probleme: Während die Passagiere in der luxuriösen 1. Klasse in Saus und Braus leben, sind illegal Zugestiegene im hinteren Zugteil, dem "Tail", weggesperrt. Essen ist streng rationiert. Bei Aufruhr drohen brutale Strafen! Als es zu einem bizarren Tötungsdelikt kommt, erhofft sich die Zugführerin Melanie Cavill Unterstützung aus der letzten Klasse. Der Kriminalpolizist Andre Layton soll dabei helfen, den Mörder zu fassen.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: Gut festhalten - Die Erde hat sich durch eine globale Klimakatastrophe in eine gewaltige Kugel aus Eis und Schnee verwandelt. Die letzten Überlebenden befinden sich im "Snowpiercer", einem futuristischen Zug, der durch die gefrorene Welt fährt und zur Zufluchtsstätte geworden ist. Auch der Kriminalpolizist Andre Layton (Daveed Diggs) und die Chefingenieurin Melanie Cavill (Jennifer Connelly) sind an Bord des Superzugs, wo strenge Hierarchien herrschen. Zwar gibt es Hoffnung auf ein Ende der Eiszeit, aber bis es soweit ist, entbrennt in den Waggons ein schonungsloser Klassenkampf. - Die postapokalyptisch-dystopische Sciencefiction-Serie basiert auf dem französischen Comicbuch "Le Transperceneige".

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids is a brand-new 3D animated musical series created by Leqing Media. With lively and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the warm and joyful daily adventures of Domi and his family of five. The show features diverse themes, captivating stories, and vibrant scenes. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a delightful audiovisual experience for children. With positive and entertaining content, the series helps young kids learn about the world at an age-appropriate pace while supporting parents in making parenting easier and more enjoyable.

programme.desc: Protecting Healthy Foods At All Costs!

programme.title: Chefclub Kids
programme.desc: With Chefclub Kids, the little ones get their hands dirty all while having fun in the kitchen. Whether they're learning to prepare dinner, bake goodies, or explore new flavors, Chefclub Kids is a way for children to gain confidence through cooking!

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger is a 3D animated musical series designed by the BarryTiger brand for children aged 1-8. With delightful and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the everyday adventures of BarryTiger and his friends. The show features a wide range of themes, diverse scenes, and captivating content. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a true audiovisual feast for children.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!

programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. From the Amazon jungles to the deepest oceans, and to the hottest deserts, Paula and friends solve problems, have fun and make more friends along the way!

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Bino & Fino
programme.desc: Bino & Fino is about a brother and sister named Bino and Fino who live with their grandparents 'Mama' and 'Papa' in a modern day city in Africa. Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Rishto Ki Dor
रिश्तो की डोर
ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்
రిష్తో కి డోర్
programme.desc: A collection of stories from people's daily lives, which teaches valuable lessons about being a good human being, is presented.
लोगों के दैनिक जीवन की कहानियों का संग्रह प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे इंसान बनने के लिए अच्छे सबक सिखाता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க பாடங்களைக் கற்பிக்கும், மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையிலிருந்து வரும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Rishto Ki Dor
रिश्तो की डोर
ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்
రిష్తో కి డోర్
programme.desc: A collection of stories from people's daily lives, which teaches valuable lessons about being a good human being, is presented.
लोगों के दैनिक जीवन की कहानियों का संग्रह प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे इंसान बनने के लिए अच्छे सबक सिखाता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க பாடங்களைக் கற்பிக்கும், மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையிலிருந்து வரும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au fond des bois
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La chasse au Big Foot
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Secrets enfouis
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque des Grenouilles-Mutantes
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mauvais rêves
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fou du volant
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les yeux de la Chimère
programme.desc: Donatello teste un nouvel appareil sur April, censé mesurer ses pouvoirs psychiques. Mais par un phénomène étrange, elle se met à voir à travers les yeux d'un volatile mutant géant, mélange de lombric, d'oiseau, et de poisson.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Quête spirituelle
programme.desc: Leonardo se fait attaquer par un daim dans la forêt, suite à quoi, il décide d'organiser une retraite pour lui et ses frères afin de se reconnecter avec Mère Nature.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Retour à New York
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent par un flash info que tout va bien à New York, mais que la ville a été mise en quarantaine. Ce message est tout sauf rassurant, et elles décident de retourner dans la grosse pomme.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Chasse au serpent
programme.desc: Les tortues retournent dans leur ancien repaire. Elles en ramènent des souvenirs et autres objets précieux. Leonardo a récupéré le vieux portrait de famille de Maître Splinter. Quand celui-ci revoit Karaï bébé, son émotion est vive et perceptible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Rhinocéros et le Cochon
programme.desc: Les tortues poursuivent leur mission qui est de retrouver Karaï. Elles ne disposent que d'un seul indice et se séparent pour chercher dans plusieurs lieux sélectionnés par Donnie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La Bataille de New York, première partie
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, première partie
programme.desc: Mikey joue dans le laboratoire de Donnie et fabrique accidentellement du rétro-mutagène. Splinter ordonne aux quatre frères de rendre leur apparence humaine aux New-Yorkais krang-formés par les Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie
programme.desc: Les tortues embarquent dans leur ballon dirigeable et partent à l'assaut de la Dimension X.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Casey Jones combat le crime
programme.desc: Casey Jones garde une dent contre les tortues, pour ne pas avoir été du voyage dans la Dimension X. Il aura à cœur de démontrer que la ville de New York peut compter sur lui comme justicier.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Vengeur toxique
programme.desc: Shredder envoie Rocksteady et Bebop récupérer des produits chimiques pour mettre au point un sérum de manipulation mentale pour Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le choc des Mutanimaux
programme.desc: Shredder et Stockman la mouche tiennent enfin la substance indispensable pour mettre au point leur formule de contrôle de la pensée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mon nom est Mondo Gecko
programme.desc: Casey et Mikey font du skate et rencontrent un nouveau mutant, Jason, qui est devenu un gecko.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le venin mortel
programme.desc: Stockman mouche a rendu sa forme humaine à Karaï. Il lui enfonce un parasite dans l'oreille, qui conditionne son cerveau à obéir aux ordres de Shredder sans discuter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Perdus dans le temps
programme.desc: Leo et ses frères font une étrange rencontre, venue du futur. La jeune et belle Reinette est poursuivie par un horrible démon mutant du nom de Savanti Romero. Celui-ci veut lui subtiliser le Sceptre du Temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende des Yokaï
programme.desc: Les quatre frères poursuivent leur voyage dans le temps et se retrouvent au Japon, dans un passé pas si lointain. Aucune trace de Reinette. Par contre, ils sont cernés par des ninjas du clan Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque du Méga Shredder
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives ratées et une entorse au pied, les tortues réussissent à s'introduire dans le labo de Stockman la mouche et dérober un parasite du cerveau. Le but : permettre à Donnie d'inverser le processus et de sauver Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'herbe-barjot
programme.desc: Mikey fait l'idiot dans le labo de Donnie, qui travaille sur un nouveau sérum anti-parasite destiné à Karaï. À force de jouer, il fait tomber des flacons d'une étagère au contenu dangereux et renverse le sérum sur Donnie, mais pas seulement.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Piège puissance quatre
programme.desc: À l'aide des Mascottes de Baxter Stockman, Karaï parvient à attirer les tortues une à une. Elle veut ainsi pousser Splinter à l'affronter en duel. Mais son plan machiavélique ne s'arrête pas là...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Un dinosaure dans les égouts !
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (1/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'anéantissement de la Terre (2/2)
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au-delà des frontières de l'espace
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les lunes de Thalos 3
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le monde selon Wyrm
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le chasseur de primes
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'énigme des Anciens Eons
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.
